sources.title: Introducing GPT-5.1 for developers
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The November 13, 2025 announcement explicitly releases gpt-5.1-codex-mini in the API and identifies the Codex variants as coding-agent models. Its appendix compares general GPT-5.1 and GPT-5 performance; it supplies no mini nominal total, active count or counted-base lineage.

sources.title: Codex changelog
sources.evidence: Complete HTML fetched and relevant text inspected. November 13, 2025 explicitly introduces gpt-5.1-codex-mini in Codex alongside the API launch; the distinct gpt-5-codex-mini appeared November 7. April 7, 2026 entry announces removal of this exact 5.1 mini from Codex with ChatGPT sign-in on April 14.

sources.title: GPT-5.1-Codex Mini model documentation
sources.evidence: Reopened exact current documentation October 27, 2026, including the complete Markdown fetched at 16:22 UTC. It identifies the alias, 400,000 context, 128,000 maximum output, text/image input, text output, reasoning, function calling and caching. It explicitly calls Mini a smaller version of GPT-5.1-Codex, without numerical total/active counts or structural details; this does not establish equal-size inheritance from the full model.

sources.title: Prompt caching
sources.evidence: Current guide explicitly names gpt-5.1-codex-mini in the extended-retention support list, independently corroborating exact-model caching capability.

sources.title: Prompt Caching 201
sources.evidence: Archived guide explicitly applies to models before GPT-5.6 and explains prompt caching through Transformer attention-layer key/value projections and tensors. Together with exact model support this permits a qualified operational Transformer inference, not a full block or routing specification.

sources.title: File inputs
sources.evidence: Responses PDF input is converted into extracted text and page images for models with vision. This establishes an API file format when joined to exact mini image and Responses support, not another native modality.

sources.title: API deprecations
sources.evidence: April 22, 2026 notice explicitly records gpt-5.1-codex-mini API shutdown on July 23, 2026. This agrees with current model-page status and is separate from earlier Codex ChatGPT-sign-in retirement.

sources.title: OpenAI Services Agreement
sources.evidence: Current sections 2.2 and 9.1 grant limited service access and reserve service intellectual-property rights. Supports descriptive proprietary classification, not an open checkpoint license or reconstruction of exact launch-day terms.

sources.title: All OpenAI API models
sources.evidence: Current catalog lists exact GPT-5.1-Codex Mini as a retired hosted model, separately from its explicit open-weight gpt-oss section.

sources.title: GPT-5.1-Codex-Max System Card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 HTTP-200 copy of the 27-page November 18, 2025 card was reopened. Introduction and benchmark tables cover GPT-5.1-Codex-Max and other full-size models. Full extracted-text searches found no exact GPT-5.1-Codex-Mini row or total/active parameter disclosure. Max training and compaction are not transferred.

sources.title: Update to GPT-5 System Card: GPT-5.2
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 HTTP-200 copy of the 27-page December 11, 2025 card was reopened. Model Data and Training and 13 benchmark tables do not supply a nominal total or activated count for GPT-5.1-Codex-Mini; full text has no exact-mini entry. Thinking, Instant and Codex-Max comparisons do not establish Mini size.

sources.title: A Practical Approach to Verifying Code at Scale
sources.evidence: Reopened October 27, 2026. The original Codex-team study describes dedicated reviewer training and compares accuracy against inference token budget. It names GPT-5-Codex, GPT-5.1-Codex and Codex-Max, with no exact-mini count. Its generator/reviewer same-model statement is not a Mini-to-full-model size relationship.

sources.title: GPT-5.1 Instant and GPT-5.1 Thinking System Card Addendum
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 HTTP-200 copy of the original November 12, 2025 addendum checked. Its five pages concern Instant/Thinking safety evaluations, with no exact Codex-Mini model specification or total/active count. ChatGPT Auto routing is not evidence of Mini expert routing.

sources.title: GPT-5.2-Codex System Card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 HTTP-200 22-page PDF checked for later disclosure. Introduction and tables identify GPT-5.2-Codex and compare full GPT-5.1-Codex/Max. Full-text searches found no GPT-5.1-Codex-Mini entry or numerical total/active parameters; Table 4 contains destructive-action avoidance scores, not counts.

sources.title: GPT-5.3-Codex System Card
sources.evidence: Fresh October 27 HTTP-200 31-page February 5, 2026 card checked. Its introduction and retrospective Codex comparison tables describe capabilities and safety results. Full text contains no exact GPT-5.1-Codex-Mini row or total/active parameter specification.

sources.title: GPT 5.1 Codex Mini pricing — rejected parameter lead
sources.evidence: Opened October 27, 2026 along with its linked duplicate listing. The catalog prints 5B total but provides no developer source or measurement for that number; its provenance section covers prices and its disclaimer describes third-party aggregation. The operator-confirmed duplicate concerns identity, not count provenance. Rejected as an unsupported secondary claim; not used as a model specification.

sources.title: GPT-5.1 Codex mini versus gpt-oss-20b — original benchmark comparison
sources.evidence: Opened October 27, 2026 while checking later total/active comparison tables. The exact Codex Mini column is blank in both rows; 21B total and 3.6B active belong to gpt-oss-20b. This original benchmark page supplies no nominal Mini count, and its generic dense-model explanation cannot establish Mini routing or active size.

parameters_b.note: Fresh October 27 re-audit reopened the exact launch/specification, original GPT-5.1 addendum, later Codex cards and original reviewer research. No developer-published nominal total or usable counted-base lineage was found. The explicit smaller-version relationship does not preserve full Codex size. Targeted exact-name searches for later research/model-team tables found no supported count; SuperBased's unsourced 5B catalog claim was rejected. This is a bounded review, not a demand for an exact tensor census.

active_parameters_b.note: Separately rechecked activated/active-parameter searches and later original Codex comparison tables on October 27. No exact-mini nominal active count or routing specification was found. The original Artificial Analysis comparison leaves Mini total/active cells blank; neighboring gpt-oss counts are another model. Neither price, inference-token budget nor the smaller-version description supports dense equality or an active-count transfer.

architecture.note: Qualified cross-source operational inference: exact mini supports prompt caching, and the applicable pre-GPT-5.6 guide explains Transformer attention KV projections. This does not establish exclusive Transformer layers, complete block inventory, dimensions, dense/MoE routing or parameter counts.

context_window.note: Exact API context window. The separate 128,000 maximum output is not added to it; no maximum input is stated or derived. Compaction behavior of other Codex models does not change this limit.

modalities.note: Native inputs are text/image and output is text. PDF denotes Responses API preprocessing into text/page images for the documented vision model; absence of a file_uploads flag is not a documented denial.

reasoning.note: Exact mini documentation explicitly supports reasoning tokens. General GPT-5.1 none-mode defaults are not transferred to this variant.

tool_call.note: Exact model documentation explicitly supports function calling in Responses.

patch.notes: GPT-5.1-Codex Mini launched in Codex and the API on November 13, 2025, separately from GPT-5-Codex-Mini on November 7. Its API page lists only the undated alias, with no dated immutable snapshot. Context is 400,000 tokens and maximum output is 128,000; no maximum input is stated. PDF denotes API conversion into text and page images. Transformer is a qualified operational inference from exact caching support and the pre-GPT-5.6 attention-KV explanation; complete block design and dense/MoE routing remain undisclosed. Total and active parameter counts remain undisclosed after the October 27 source review; the documented smaller-version relationship supplies no nominal size or count-preserving base lineage. Codex access with ChatGPT sign-in ended April 14, 2026, and API access shut down July 23, 2026. These are last-documented capabilities; no inference request was made.

summary: October 27 parameter re-audit retained null/undisclosed total and active counts after fresh exact-model documentation, original GPT-5.1 and later Codex cards, reviewer research and targeted research-table searches. Rejected the unreferenced SuperBased 5B listing; the original benchmark comparison leaves both Mini counts blank. Added explicit null patches and fresh evidence. Preserved the other 12 assessments, including November 13 identity, 400K context, documented capabilities and separate Codex/API retirements.
